data.title: fleece migrate doesn't invalidate replay cache
data.description:
MigrationService.WriteSnapshotAsync (src/Fleece.Core/EventSourcing/Services/Legacy/MigrationService.cs:190) writes the snapshot directly via _fileSystem and never calls _replayCache.InvalidateAsync. If a stale .fleece/.replay-cache exists at the current HEAD SHA (e.g., from running 'fleece list' on the new event-sourced reader before 'fleece migrate' completes), the cache survives migration and EventSourcedStorageService.GetIssuesAsync (EventSourcedStorageService.cs:60) trusts it — 'fleece list' returns empty even though .fleece/issues.jsonl is populated.

Repro: on a repo with legacy issue files, upgrade to 3.1.0, run 'fleece list' once (writes empty cache at HEAD), then 'fleece migrate', then 'fleece list' — shows 'No issues found'. Workaround: delete .fleece/.replay-cache.

Fix: MigrationService should call IReplayCache.InvalidateAsync after writing the snapshot, matching EventSourcedStorageService.WriteSnapshotAsync:93-100.
